title: Furmax Ribbed Office Chair High Back PU Leather Executive Conference Chair Adjustable Swivel Chair with Arms (Bicolor Retro Brown)

reviews.title: Excellent Comfort and Great Quality
reviews.body: I am very pleased with this office chair. It was simple to put together and looks very stylish in my home office. The seat is comfortable, the back support is great for long hours of work, and the PU leather has a nice premium feel. The chair rolls smoothly and the height adjustment works perfectly. It feels sturdy and well made, especially for the price. I would definitely recommend this chair to anyone looking for comfort and a professional look.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
reviews.author: Monica Martinez

reviews.title: Better than Some Expensive Models at Staples and Office Depot.
reviews.body: I usually buy the highest user rated product at the lowest price. This means spending hours reading Amazon customer comments, ConsumerSearch website, and other internet sites. After much research, I purchased two Furmax High Back Office Chairs. Here are the "good" and "bad" on this product...ADVANTAGES.1. USER RATING: This is one of the higher rated office chairs among users. As of 6/20/2018, there were no "1, 2, or 3-Star Reviews" listed. All were "4 and 5-Stars.".2. VALUE: Despite the $10 shipping cost, this is the cheapest high back office chair on the Amazon website..3. COMFORT: It is very comfortable. The cushions are thick and firm. The lower back support is superb. The chair just wraps around the contours of your body..4. QUALITY: Sitting down, it just feels luxurious. In fact, I prefer this than some of the expensive brands priced between $150 to $250 at Staples and Office Depot..5. EASE OF ASSEMBLY: The diagram is simple to follow. All hardware are provided with an Allen wrench. The pieces align accurately during assembly..6. CUSTOMER SERVICE: Their department is superb. A small problem was resolved within a day with detailed instructions and two step-by-step illustrations...DISADVANTAGES.1. UNEXPECTED PRICE INCREASE: Without warning, the price went up by $5..2. SHIPPING CONTAINER: The cardboard box is flimsy. Almost all of the packaging tape are broken during shipping..3. BETTER SEATING: For durability, the seat should be constructed of real cow hide..4. TOO MUCH STITCHING: There are just too many parts stitched together. When a thread breaks, everything comes apart..5. STITCH LOCATION: Many of the stitches are located on corners and edges which experience the most wear and human contact. Have the material wrap around these areas and stitched further down..6. ASSEMBLING THE BACK: Tilt the chair on its side when assembling the back piece to the arms. It is impossible to do this with the chair standing up, as illustrated on the installation booklet..7. HEIGHT: The platform is a bit high. People with short legs will have problems..8. NO MID-BACK VERSION: If this office chair came in an exact mid-back version, I would buy four of them..Unfortunately, the other mid-back Furman models look very uncomfortable and cheap. I purchased similar ones from Office Max years ago. The seating platform is smaller; and the foam is thin. Within a few years, the user is resting on wood. The threads also broke, exposing the insides.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 20, 2018
reviews.author: Gene P. Louie

reviews.title: very quality for the price
reviews.body: a quality chair complete with quality packaging... it is not going to be damaged in transit.  good range of comfort positions that adjusts to just about any work  situation. assembling was very easy and straight  forward with no personal tools needed and with  instructions easily followed.  my only reason for a 4/5 rating was I found the arm rests not very comfortable and non-cushioned for a long period of time on my forearms.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 18, 2026
reviews.author: Ted

reviews.title: Mediocre at best
reviews.body: Final update: So, after dealing with...well...subpar customer service conversation skills let's get down to a new review of this thing. Buy something else. Loudest chair I've ever sat in. Literally creaks and groans everytime you move. This was after about a month. The arm "leather" whatever it is, is peeling off, and the lean was NEVER fixed.So customer service, when someone says "my entire chair leans to the side, including the seat and arms" a proper response is not to send them a new back to the chair. The ENTIRE CHAIR LEANS! So what you should have done is sent the actual replacement parts you said you were going to send, instead of saying "yeah...but here's this now, good luck." Also your emails were like reading the script to smeagle in lord of the rings. this chair is...a chair, that's it. However, better chairs are most likely out there for the same price. All I'm sayin, really think about this one.Update: After a day the chair isn't straight. The entire chair tilts to the right. Removing a starSo after refusing shipment on the first chair for an extremely damaged box, the second one finally came only with less damage. The chair itself may be difficult for one person to put together when dealing with connecting the back, to the seat. The arm rests are hard, almost like air is the cushion, covered in the fabric of the chair; "PU Leather" or whatever. It is better than my old chair, however my old chair has been in use for over a decade so it isn't really comparable. Lumbar support is ok, and being 6'1" the back of the chair does go above my shoulders being able to semi comfortably lay the back of my head on the top of the backing of the chair. Depending on how this chair goes in the future, I will update my review. However for now my purchase price of $89.99 it deserves 4 stars. Would have been 5 if I didn't have to wait longer than expected, the snugness of the back and seat during assembly, and the stiffness of the armrests. It is a nice chair, with basic features, good for a sub $100 chair.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 16, 2017
reviews.author: Ross

reviews.title: Very nice chair that’s easy to assemble
reviews.body: Had an issue with the shipping and was a little late but the customer service response was quick and satisfactory. Very pleased with how it was handled. The quality of the chair is excellent and makes for a very nice value. Nice and comfortable. The seat could be a bit narrow depending on the size of a persons hips. I’m a 6ft tall 185lb man and it fits me very well. Good height adjustment, reclining is adjustable and will lean back nicely. Back support should fit the widest of backs and I would consider it to be high. Assembly was very easy. Took about 20 minutes with included tool. Packaging was nicely thought out.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on September 19, 2024
reviews.author: michael k

reviews.title: When I got this chair it was crooked!
reviews.body: At first when the chair came I was so excited. I loved the look and comfort of it. However, when I looked close at it I noticed how the handlebars don’t align with each other, the back of the chair wasn’t starlight, and last but not least the whole chair itself was crooked. In the pictures above I put a tool used to see if something is straight or crooked. The bubble was supposed to be in the middle but it’s to the left. This means that this chair is obviously not straight. This may seem like Nothing to worry about but I feel like Over time this could cause problems or Evan cause the chair to break. I beleive that if your paying $80 for a chair it should at least come looking right. At the end of the day I’m truly disappointed with this purchase!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2020
reviews.author: L

reviews.title: Fantastic Buy!
reviews.body: I would buy this chair over and over again. The white chair with its chrome and black finish is absolutely gorgeous to look at and heavenly to sit in, it has a slight ergonomic design but, if you have back issues you’ll still need at little portable back support. It is sturdy, a great value for the cost and it’s a desk chair so I don’t have to move it but it’s on rollers if I do. Hubby put this together without any headaches! I LOVE THIS CHAIR, OMGOODNESS!!!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 9, 2026
reviews.author: Candylee

reviews.title: Now that I'm working from home
reviews.body: I bought this chair over a year ago, it was fairly easy to assemble, but once all put together I noticed it was leaning. I tried to put pressure on the opposite side to get it straight but it never straightened up. I didn't mind it as much because I didn't use it much. Now that I've been working from home for the past 4 months, this chair is the most uncomfortable thing to sit in. I have scoliosis so sitting for long periods aggravates my back, but sitting in a chair with a slight lean is even more detrimental. With that said, the chair is cheap and worth the price. If you need something for aesthetics alone, get it. If you're looking for something that is comfortable and ergonomic keep it moving.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 5, 2020
